title: Recovery-Induced Erasure Attack on QKD Systems
summary: Detector dead time is typically treated as a fixed parameter in quantum key distribution (QKD) security analyses. In practice, however, the effective recovery time of single-photon avalanche photodiodes (SPADs) depends on the incident count rate. In this work, we demonstrate that this count-rate-dependent recovery nonlinearity constitutes a distinct attack primitive. We experimentally characterize the dead time shift of a free-running SPAD under controlled broadband loading and observe a substantial increase in effective recovery time as the detected rate rises into the high photon count…
